description: IrriMap_CN provides annual maps of irrigated cropland across China from 2000 to 2019 at 500-metre resolution. They were produced from MODIS data and environmental variables with a machine-learning classifier on Google Earth Engine, trained on samples from the statistics-constrained IrriMap_Syn maps by the same team. The authors, Chao Zhang, Jinwei Dong and Quansheng Ge, describe the method in Remote Sensing of Environment (2022), and the 20 annual GeoTIFF files are free downloads from figshare under CC BY 4.0 (published July 2022). Caveats: coverage is national and ends in 2019, and 500-metre pixels mix irrigated and rainfed fields in fragmented landscapes. Simulation uses: the annual pattern of irrigated area in China for irrigation capacity planning and climate adaptation. Related record: GMIE (data-gmie-global-maximum-irrigation-extent).
